# TrusComp

> TrusComp Private Limited is a Chennai (Tamil Nadu, India) based, technology-driven labour law and statutory compliance company. TrusComp delivers end-to-end compliance solutions across India, covering labour law compliance management, payroll compliance, statutory records and registers, licences and registrations, remittances and returns, vendor and contractor audits, factory compliance, and compliance risk assessment for enterprises, manufacturers, and Global Capability Centres (GCCs).

## About TrusComp

- Legal name: TrusComp Private Limited (TrusComp Pvt. Ltd.)
- Industry: Labour law compliance, statutory compliance, payroll compliance, HR and regulatory technology
- Headquarters: No. 9, 3rd Floor, Pe Ve Plaza, Lakshmi Nagar, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600116, India
- Service area: Pan-India, all states and union territories
- Contact: info@truscomp.com | +91 87540 48634
- Serves: enterprises, manufacturers, factories, Global Capability Centres (GCCs), HR and payroll teams, and public and private sector organisations in regulated industries including healthcare, manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals

## Services

### Labor law Compliance

- [End-to-End Labor Law Compliance Management](https://www.truscomp.com/services/end-to-end-labor-law-compliance-management): End-to-end management of statutory obligations for organisations operating across multiple states, covering registrations, records, filings, remittances, and inspections under a single accountable framework.
- [Wage Restructuring & Compliance Under the New Labour Codes](https://www.truscomp.com/services/wage-restructuring-compliance-under-the-new-labour-codes): Wage structure review and restructuring to align salary components, statutory contributions, and employee benefits with India's new labour code framework.

### Licensing & Registration

- [Compliance Calendar](https://www.truscomp.com/services/compliance-calendar): TrusComp’s automated compliance calendars are designed to track critical timelines and ensure you never miss a deadline.
- [Records & Registers Compliance – Automated Solutions by TrusComp](https://www.truscomp.com/services/records-registers-compliance-automated-solutions-by-truscomp): Ensure 100% statutory compliance with TrusComp’s automated solutions for generating and managing mandatory records and registers.
- [Licenses & Registrations (Renewals & Amendments)](https://www.truscomp.com/services/licenses-registrations-renewals-amendments): TrusComp simplifies licensing and registration processes, ensuring seamless applications, renewals, and amendments with minimal effort.

### Payroll & Remittances

- [Remittances & Return’s – Automated Compliance by TrusComp](https://www.truscomp.com/services/remittances-returns-automated-compliance-by-truscomp): TrusComp simplifies compliance with automated processes for timely and accurate remittances and returns.
- [Payroll Compliance](https://www.truscomp.com/services/payroll-compliance): Ensure accurate deductions, timely filings, and seamless compliance management with our automated Payroll Compliance platform.

### Audit & Verification

- [Inspection Handling & Audit Appearance](https://www.truscomp.com/services/inspection-handling-audit-appearance): TrusComp ensures your organization is fully prepared for inspections and audits with automated compliance tracking and expert representation.
- [Vendor Audit](https://www.truscomp.com/services/vendor-audit): Streamline vendor audits with TrusComp’s comprehensive compliance solutions for complete visibility and risk management.
- [Employer Audit (S&E and Factory)](https://www.truscomp.com/services/employer-audit-se-and-factory): Ensure seamless compliance with state and central regulations through TrusComp’s thorough and automated employer audits.
- [Contractor Compliance Solutions](https://www.truscomp.com/services/contractor-compliance-solutions): Ensure Safety, Mitigate Risks, and Boost Efficiency with Our Cutting-Edge Platform.

### Compliance

- [Factory Compliance Solutions](https://www.truscomp.com/services/factory-compliance-solutions): Simplifying Compliance for Safe and Efficient Manufacturing Operations
- [Compliance Risk Assessment](https://www.truscomp.com/services/compliance-risk-assessment): Proactively safeguard your organization with TrusComp’s expert-led Compliance Risk Assessment.

### Training

- [Training and Awareness Programs](https://www.truscomp.com/services/training-and-awareness-programs): Empower your employees and vendors with TrusComp’s engaging compliance training and awareness programs.

### General

- [UAN and IP Generation (SS Bot – Social Security Bot)](https://www.truscomp.com/services/uan-and-ip-generation-ss-bot-social-security-bot): Simplify your social security compliance processes with TrusComp’s advanced SS Bot.

### Global Capability Centres

- [Global Capability Center (GCC) Compliance](https://www.truscomp.com/services/gcc): Compliance advisory, entity structuring, and ongoing statutory support for multinational companies setting up and scaling Global Capability Centres in India, covering labour law, payroll, and statutory obligations from day one.

## Tools

- [Wage Impact Calculator](https://www.truscomp.com/calculator): Free calculator to model how the new Indian labour codes and wage definitions affect an organisation's salary structure, statutory contributions, and overall cost to company.
